source.quote: Novo Nordisk A/S is controlled by Novo Holdings A/S (incorporated in Denmark), which owns 28.1% of the share capital in Novo Nordisk A/S, representing 77.3% of the total number of votes.

structure.note: A shares (1,074,872,000, unlisted, 100 votes each) are all held by Novo Holdings A/S, which is wholly owned by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and cannot divest them; B shares (3,390,128,000 issued, 10 votes each) are listed in Copenhagen and as ADRs on the NYSE. With its A shares plus B shares of nominally DKK 17,756,050, Novo Holdings held 28.1% of the capital and 77.3% of the votes at 31 December 2025. In practice A and B shares receive the same dividend per share.

notes: Fiscal year ended 31 December 2025. Sources are Novo Nordisk's Annual Report 2025, Remuneration Report 2025 and Form 20-F 2025 (PDFs on novonordisk.com). DKK, converted exactly from DKK million. LEADER: Lars Fruergaard Jørgensen stepped down as president and CEO on 6 August 2025 and was succeeded by Maziar Mike Doustdar on 7 August 2025. The Remuneration Report's table of executives' shareholdings at 31 December 2025 no longer includes him (it lists Doustdar, Karsten Munk Knudsen and non-registered executives), and the 20-F gives only the group total of board members and executives (1,173,813 B shares, 0.03% of the class). No holding is reported, so status is 'no-reported-stake'; this does not mean he holds no shares (he held 590,550 B shares at 31 December 2024). HOLDER: Novo Holdings A/S's 28.1% is of total share capital (A plus B), so it is economic; its 77.3% voting share comes from the A shares' 100 votes. The Novo Nordisk Foundation's interest is the same holding (it owns Novo Holdings 100%), so it is not listed separately. The 20-F lists no other holder above 5% of any class (as of 3 February 2026). DIVIDENDS: DKK 51,763 million paid to all shareholders including Novo Holdings. BUYBACKS: DKK 1,388 million purchase of treasury shares in 2025; a new programme of up to DKK 15 billion began on 4 February 2026, after the fiscal year. STOCK COMP: DKK 1,435 million total share-based payment expense (note 5.1). GEOGRAPHY: the five reported areas under the new 2025 structure (USA, plus International Operations split into EUCAN, Emerging Markets, APAC and Region China); comparatives were restated.
